summary: Verified per-employee AFP/ARS/ISR deduction toggles (iter 211). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_employee_deduction_toggles.py with 5 pytest tests, ALL 5 PASS. Verified (1) PUT /api/people-ops/employees/emp_91f4dfa58d68 persists has_pension/has_health_insurance/has_isr booleans; biweekly payroll entry correctly shows afp_employee=0 when has_pension=false, ars_employee~1140 (biweekly 37500*3.04%) when has_health_insurance=true, isr=0 when has_isr=false. (2) GET /api/people-ops/payroll/projection?period_type=biweekly honors toggles (afp=0/isr=0 when off; all non-zero when on). (3) Restoring toggles to all true → all deductions non-zero. (4) Toggle takes precedence over override: has_pension=false + afp_override=2000 → afp=0; has_pension=true + afp_override=2000 → afp=1000 biweekly. (5) Backward compat: employee doc with has_isr/has_pension/has_health_insurance completely absent (via $unset) is treated as True — projection returns non-zero afp/ars/isr. Frontend: logged into /people-ops/employee/emp_91f4dfa58d68, Compensation tab renders 'Benefits & Deductions' card with three toggles (data-testid=toggle-afp/toggle-ars/toggle-isr). In display mode shows On/Off badges (app locale=EN so Activo/Exento text is 'On'/'Off'). Edit mode reveals Switch components; toggling AFP off → Save → reload → GET /employees confirms has_pension=false persisted. Restored employee to has_pension=has_isr=has_health_insurance=true, afp_override=null, ars_override=null after test — verified via curl.

issues: Locale mismatch: demo.agency user's active language is English so the badge text renders as 'On'/'Off' (not 'Activo'/'Exento' as spec described). Code correctly falls back via ternary — this is not a bug, just noting that the Spanish text 'Exento' only appears when isEs=true. Frontend test verified functional behavior via data-state and API round-trip; badge red-text class was not asserted post-reload because the reloaded page retained edit mode (page.reload preserved query state and re-opened editing) — the toggle Switch itself showed unchecked state confirming persistence.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly uses `is not False` pattern (routers/people_ops.py lines 1992-1994 and 2410-2412) so any employee with the field absent OR set to True gets deductions calculated. Explicit False disables. Backward compatible.
Toggle takes precedence over override in both create_payroll_period and payroll_projection (checked before override branch). Confirmed via test_toggle_overrides_manual_override.
update_employee uses exclude_unset=True and filters None (keeps clearable override fields nullable). Boolean False values pass through correctly since `False is not None`. No changes needed.

Frontend Switch components use `checked={editData.has_pension !== false}` — correctly treats undefined/true as checked. Badge className uses `employee.has_pension === false` (strict False) for red styling — this matches backend convention.
